steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Configure app metadata with app name KKG Store and package name com.kkgstore.store.

steps.title: Update Database Schema for Photo Support
steps.description: Upgrade SQLite DatabaseHelper to version 2 with photo_path support in udhaar_entries table and safe migration.

steps.title: Implement Image Storage & Compression Utilities
steps.description: Develop ImageUtils to resize photos to max 1280px, apply 70% JPEG compression, adjust EXIF rotation, and store in private files/udhar_photos directory.

steps.title: Implement Full-Screen Image Viewer
steps.description: Create FullScreenImageActivity layout and touch-interactive viewer with close X button for full offline photo viewing.

steps.title: Update Add Udhaar Layout with Camera & Gallery Controls
steps.description: Add camera capture and gallery photo picker action buttons, preview thumbnail, and clear photo controls to Udhaar dialog.

steps.title: Update Udhaar Item List View with Clickable Photo Thumbnail
steps.description: Add thumbnail preview layout element to item_udhaar.xml for rendering attached Udhar receipt photos.

steps.title: Integrate Camera Capture & Photo Display into Customer Details
steps.description: Connect photo capture result handlers, photo path persistence, thumbnail click listeners, and full-screen viewer intent in CustomerDetailActivity.

steps.title: Update Reports & Full Data ZIP Backup/Restore System
steps.description: Update ReportsActivity ZIP backup and restore functionality to pack/unpack database file along with all stored Udhar photos in files/udhar_photos.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Declare Camera permissions and full-screen image viewer activity in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Building KKG Store
steps.description: Compile and assemble the updated APK package for KKG Store with Udhar photo capture and backup features.
